comparison.objective: Install two hook-in gondola brackets and seat a shelf; candidate adjusts and validates a robot-axis damper.
comparison.physical_skill: PR requires pitched hook insertion, swing-down seating, repeated bracket placement, and bimanual shelf handling. Candidate requires fine tool engagement, captive setscrew loosening/relocking, collar adjustment, and dynamic feedback iteration.
comparison.success_condition: PR scores seated hooks/tongues and a stable released shelf, with drop and sequencing failures. Candidate scores two repeatable safe impact stops and rejects bottoming, excessive forces, rebound, drift, damage, and unsafe cycling.
comparison.reason: Hook-and-shelf assembly tests constrained installation, not adjustment and dynamic commissioning.
